name: Tooltip
summary: A short note that appears when the reader points at a word or tabs to it. The bubble is drawn by the stylesheet and placed with absolute positioning; the trigger is a real button, so the keyboard opens it as well as the pointer.
summaryZh: 读者指向一个词、或者用 Tab 走到它时出现的一小段说明。气泡由样式表画出来,靠绝对定位摆好;触发器是一个真正的 button,所以键盘和指针都能打开它。

variants.name: Above the trigger
variants.note: The bubble hangs above the trigger and its arrow points down at it.

variants.name: Left of the trigger
variants.note: The bubble stands to the left of the trigger and its arrow points across at it.

variants.name: Right of the trigger
variants.note: The bubble stands to the right of the trigger and its arrow points across at it.

states.name: Pointed at
states.note: The pointer is over the wrapper, so the bubble is shown.

states.name: Focused
states.note: The focus is inside the wrapper, so the bubble is shown. This is the keyboard half: it fires for the trigger whatever element it is.

states.name: Focus ring
states.note: The trigger takes the shared focus ring, so a keyboard reader can see where they are.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The tooltip is not asked for, so the bubble never opens.

states.name: Not enterable
states.note: The pointer cannot enter the bubble: the words in it cannot be selected and the pointer passes straight through it.

states.name: Visible
states.note: The bubble is held open, whether the pointer is on the trigger or not.

states.name: No arrow
states.note: The point that says which way the bubble is facing is not drawn.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.note: The button or link the bubble belongs to. It has to be focusable: a span the library drew is not, and a tooltip the keyboard cannot open is half a tooltip.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The bubble. It is absolutely positioned and hidden until the wrapper is pointed at or focused.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: A square turned on its corner. It sits inside the bubble, because the bubble is what it is positioned against, and its edges take the bubble's border colour so the point reads as part of the bubble rather than as a shape stuck on it.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the bubble sits relative to the trigger. The bottom placement is the base class on its own; the other three add um-tooltip--top, um-tooltip--left or um-tooltip--right.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡相对触发器的位置。bottom 就是只写基础类;另外三个分别加上 um-tooltip--top、um-tooltip--left、um-tooltip--right。

props.name: text
props.description: The words in the bubble. It is written as text in the page, and the trigger points at it with aria-describedby so the reader hears it as a description rather than as a stray paragraph.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡里的那段话。它以正文写进页面,触发器用 aria-describedby 指向它,这样读屏会把它当作描述,而不是一段冒出来的文字。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the tooltip is switched off. A disabled tooltip never opens. It adds um-tooltip--disabled.
props.descriptionZh: 提示是否关闭。关闭的提示不会弹出来。它加上 um-tooltip--disabled。

props.name: enterable
props.description: Whether the pointer can enter the bubble. A bubble that cannot be entered lets the pointer through it, so the words in it cannot be selected. It adds um-tooltip--not-enterable.
props.descriptionZh: 指针能否进入气泡。不可进入的气泡会让指针穿过去,里面的字也就选不中。它加上 um-tooltip--not-enterable。

props.name: show-arrow
props.description: Whether the bubble carries the point that says which way it faces. A bubble without one adds um-tooltip--no-arrow.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡是否带着那个指方向的尖角。没有尖角的气泡加上 um-tooltip--no-arrow。

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the bubble is held open. It adds um-tooltip--visible.
props.descriptionZh: 气泡是否常显。它加上 um-tooltip--visible。

a11y.notes: The trigger is a real <button> or <a>, so it is in the tab order and the browser announces it; the bubble is a plain span with role="tooltip", and the trigger points at it with aria-describedby so the reader hears the note as a description of the trigger. The bubble opens on focus as well as on hover, so the keyboard reaches everything the pointer reaches. A CSS-only tooltip cannot be dismissed with Escape — the bubble closes when the focus leaves the trigger.
a11y.notesZh: 触发器是真正的 <button> 或 <a>,所以它在 Tab 顺序里,浏览器也会播报它;气泡是一个带 role="tooltip" 的 span,触发器用 aria-describedby 指向它,读屏就会把这段说明当作触发器的描述。气泡在聚焦时也会打开,不只是鼠标悬停时,所以键盘能碰到的东西和指针能碰到的一样多。纯 CSS 的文字提示没法用 Escape 关掉 —— 焦点离开触发器时它就收起来。

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A button with a note under it. The bubble is written after the trigger and points at it with aria-describedby.
examples.descriptionZh: 一个按钮,底下跟一段说明。气泡写在触发器后面,并用 aria-describedby 指向它。
examples.markup: Compares the two ledgers and writes the differences back.

examples.title: Placements
examples.description: The base class puts the bubble under the trigger. The three modifiers move it above, to the left or to the right, and turn the arrow to match.
examples.descriptionZh: 基础类把气泡放在触发器下面。三个修饰类把它挪到上面、左边或右边,箭头也跟着转。
examples.markup: The bubble hangs above the trigger. The bubble stands to the left. The bubble stands to the right.

examples.title: A link as the trigger
examples.description: The trigger does not have to be a button. A link works the same way, and it is announced as a link rather than as a button.
examples.descriptionZh: 触发器不一定是按钮。链接一样能用,而且它会被播报成链接,不是按钮。
examples.markup: the runbook How a failed run is put back in order, step by step.

notes: The arrow is a square turned on its corner, with its two lower edges carrying the bubble's border colour and its fill taken from the bubble's own surface. That is what makes the point read as part of the bubble instead of a shape glued to it — the border line stops at the arrow and picks up on the other side.
notesZh: 箭头是一个转过 45 度的方块,靠两条边带着气泡的描边色,填充用的是气泡自己的底色。这样那个尖角才读得出是气泡的一部分,而不是粘上去的一个形状 —— 描边走到箭头这里断一下,再从另一边接上。
